visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation intro phase. A green circular swirling graphic with a hypnotic pattern occupies the background. Yellow text overlays '事出必有因' at the top and purple/blue text '都是鬼月惹的禍' in the center. A small circular profile logo for '@這群人' is visible on the left side. (2) Office setting phase. A young woman wearing a black blazer and white shirt (Main Character) has her eyes squinted and mouth open in a grimace of physical pain. Her hands are pressed against her lower abdomen while she hunches forward. In the background, there is an office partition decorated with colored sticky notes and stationery. A second woman with long dark hair and a neutral gaze peers mysteriously over the main character's shoulder. (3) Residential living room scene. A young man in a black suit and white shirt rubs his neck with his right hand, tilting his head with an uncomfortable, strained facial expression. The mysterious female character reappears directly behind his neck, looking into the camera with wide eyes. The lighting is warm and bright, illuminating home decorations and furniture in the background. (4) Bedroom setting. A woman in a dark grey oversized sweatshirt sits on a bed, holding her forehead with one hand. She looks dizzy and disoriented, with a tired facial expression. Shelves behind her are filled with various small decorative toys and collectibles in a shallow depth-of-field shot. The lighting is soft and natural coming from the side. (5) Dialogue scene in a bright clinical or medical-style office. A man in a white professional coat (Doctor or Optometrist style) sits at a desk holding a white and blue milk carton. He looks frustrated and annoyed, speaking directly to the mysterious girl who is leaning her head on his shoulder in a clingy manner. Yellow and white subtitles appear consistently at the bottom of the frame.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 事出必有因. [Logo]: @這群人. [Variety]: 都是鬼月惹的禍. [Slogan]: 完整版這群人 迷不迷信經典語錄. (2) [Slogan]: 【農曆七月半系列】One Day in the Ghost Month - 都是鬼月惹的禍 -. [Subtitle]: 這次經期好不舒服. (3) [Subtitle]: 肚子好痛.... [Subtitle]: 是鬼月. (4) [Subtitle]: 吼....不知道為什麼 最近覺得肩膀好痠 肩頸很不舒服. [Subtitle]: 是鬼月. (5) [Subtitle]: 我耳石好像脫落 超量超不舒服的. [Subtitle]: 是鬼月. (6) [Subtitle]: 啊！吼吼！我在幹嘛！. [Subtitle]: 是鬼月. (7) [Subtitle]: 奇怪這位置怎麼動過 誰敢有夠.... [Subtitle]: 是鬼月. (8) [Subtitle]: 突然間眼壓好高喔. [Subtitle]: 是鬼月. (9) [Subtitle]: 茵聲妳拜託好不好 不要什麼都鬼月好不好 我只是眼壓高滑太多手機而已. (10) [Subtitle]: 展瑞你不要再鐵齒 這就是因為鬼月的關係 才會造成這麼多事情. (11) [Subtitle]: 那請問一下我剛喝這個沒有過期的牛奶 發現它已經壞掉了 這難道也是鬼月嗎？ [Subtitle]: 當然是鬼月 不然它莫名其妙怎麼會過期.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A lively, mid-tempo comedic synthesizer theme begins with a strong, rhythmic drum beat. A female voice speaks with high intensity and a pained, strained vocal quality. Immediately, a distinct 'Ding' chime SFX triggers a female whisper with low arousal and breathy tone saying 'It's ghost month.' (2) A 'Whoosh' transition SFX leads into a male voice complaining about physical pain. His pitch is mid-range with moderate conversational loudness and clear articulation. The BGM continues as a steady loop. Another metallic 'Ding' chime is followed by the same breathy female whisper delivery of the catchphrase. (3) A sharp 'Impact' SFX marks a new phase. A female speaker uses a slow, lethargic speech rate and low pitch to describe dizziness. The BGM beat remains consistent throughout. The breathy female whisper catchphrase recurs, synchronized with a percussive comedic chime. (4) A sudden high-pitch scream and a sharp 'Zap' digital SFX occur as a character reacts to a mistake. The male voice exhibits high arousal and frantic pacing. The mysterious whisper returns again. The BGM features a short rhythmic gap or 'stinger' to emphasize the comedic timing. (5) The BGM volume ducks slightly as a linear dialogue starts. A male voice speaks with an authoritative, professional tone but high frustration intensity. A female voice responds with a playful, teasing tone and moderate speech rate. Spectral brightness is high for vocal clarity. (6) A liquid pouring 'Splash' SFX is heard as the man mentions the milk. The BGM builds up harmonic tension with a rising synth line. A final comedic 'Stinger' SFX concludes the dialogue, followed by a sudden silence for the punchline.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problems -> Superstitious Reason -> Comedic Conflict
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A comedic sketch by 'This Group of People' (TGOP) that humorously blames various everyday misfortunes and physical ailments on the superstitions associated with 'Ghost Month' in Chinese culture, concluding with an absurd argument about spoiled milk.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video focus is purely on comedic entertainment and narrative storytelling without specific brand promotion.
